verdict.rationale: The firm's own pages show ESOP-adjacent expertise: a publication analysing the ITAT ruling on Flipkart's stock-option buyback (capital gains vs. perquisite), and an Employment page that mentions "structuring of compensation and benefits". Neither page describes actually designing or drafting employee option plans. Missing for 10: an explicit practice or service description for designing Indian ESOP/option plans (drafting, regulatory and FEMA/SEBI compliance, vesting structures), coverage of phantom/SAR schemes, and any client or deal corroboration of equity-plan design work.
